svg.aria-label: EverythingTech: A daily tech newspaper with no human editor. Python pulls 47 free sources and clusters duplicate coverage. A scheduled Claude Code routine picks, ranks and writes each story from the full article, and GitHub Pages serves it. No server, no database, no API key.
